_note: The screenshots and the read-more links are the SITE'S, not the vault's.
The words on every slide come from decks/*.md in the vault, republished byte for
byte. This file adds two things the vault document does not carry and should not:
a picture of THIS SITE, and a link into it. Keyed by deck slug and slide number.
Every `shot` names a file in files/shots/ captured by tools/shots.js from the
built site; every `link` must resolve on this site, which check_links enforces.
